name: Casa VESPA at WUA LAI Boutique

attrs.description: Casa VESPA welcomes you at WUA LAI Boutique Hotel. Casa VESPA is a new hospitality concept that combines “La Dolce Vita” lifestyle with a tribute to the world’s most iconic scooter and refreshing, local experiences. Casa VESPA is a hotel for adults only.

names.en: Casa VESPA at WUA LAI Boutique
